notes.title: Content Update and Graphic Fixes 05/2025
notes.content:
Hello Exorcists!
Content Update and Graphic Fixes:

- Skip Progression: Following requests from many players, you can now skip progression! All entities and mission types are now available to you, as well as previously locked difficulties. But be careful — this doesn’t mean you’ll have the funds to succeed in all these contracts. Only “Normal” and “Rescue” contracts provide you with free equipment — don’t forget that.

To access this, go to the third page of the encyclopedia and choose your destiny… or turn back. You can also tap on your level on the tablet home screen.

- Multi-Entity Rescue Contract: You’ve been urgently called to rescue a team in distress. Be careful — multiple entities haunt the area! Their equipment is scattered around the contract site, but you won’t be able to bring your own. Stay alert!

- Surprise Contract: Tired of thinking, waiting for the right moment, and picking the right mission? It’s time to take on a random contract! Let luck decide for you by clicking in the center of the random contracts and be sent on a surprise mission.

- New colors for the Will-o'-the-Wisp, which previously felt limited.

- Graphic optimizations (software update)

- Text display optimizations (boards, tablet, environment, etc.)

- Translations other than English and French were done using Google Translate.

notes.title: Three years already!
notes.content:
[i]Hello everyone, long time no see![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40514161/0efd8251aa82df4bb0f78b4f54a13f42b3ea6133.png[/img]

We first wanted to thank those who wished Ghost Exorcism Inc. a happy birthday, and yes, [b]3 years[/b] already since the release! A lot of developments in three years, lots of laughter and jumpscares, and it would never have happened without you and your support!

We're going to answer the most asked questions in recent months, with little sneak peaks of upcoming updates ;)

[h3]Is the game still being developed?[/h3]
Yes! The game is still under development. We have always been a very small team, but that does not stop us from moving forward.
The game being at an advanced stage in terms of entities, evidence, maps and type of contracts, we continue to work on the so-called "comfort" features. But also on one last map, because we can't help it...

[h3]When will there be an official release?[/h3]
This year! If all goes well, the game will be officially released at the end of 2024. Our efforts on the network, various optimizations and the game engine in general have reached a stage that allows us to release the game. The price will not change, the discounts will continue as they always have (long live halloween!) and we hope to be able to launch some challenges and continue small updates here and there in the future, after the release.

[h3]Where to find games online?[/h3]
We have a small and passionate community, but that can mean it's more difficult for players to find public lobbies with players. If you're struggling to find random players to play with, we urge you to create a [b]public[/b] lobby for yourself, so that you can allow others searching for games to join you. There is also a Discord community available here:  [url=https://discord.gg/ghost-exorcism-inc-845591054635761704]https://discord.gg/ghost-exorcism-inc-845591054635761704[/url] and several players in the Steam community, sharing game codes and tips!

[h3]Why not rescues with several entities?[/h3]
You're right. Why not? Oh, I'm being told in the headset that it's currently being tested and will soon be in beta! Several of you (especially veterans) have asked for it. Rest assured it will be a done deal! Just like a classic multi-entity contract, the "short" mode will offer two entities and the "long" three entities in one contract. The equipment scattered on the ground, as well as the number of employees knocked out (in need of rescue) will be increased.

[h3]So, what's new between now and the release?[/h3]
- Some graphics optimizations
- New colors for our friend the Wisp (he complained of always being the same...)
- New map
- QoL improvements (in the options, in the display of certain information, etc.)
- New Multi-Entity Rescue game mode

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40514161/2b17dd51e7f6c3d0078b3487313833ea34e163af.png[/img]

[i]See you soon! Oh, and exorcists... don't forget your Mary and crucifix![/i]

notes.title: [Beta] Spectator Mode & New Entity - 12/12/2023
notes.content:
Hello Exorcists!
Back with a new public-test version before the end of 2023! Below you will find a summary of this update, but first..

[i][b]-- New Entity[/b][/i]
Since the offices of Ghost Exorcism Inc. have been able to analyze paranormal fires, several discoveries have been made, such as notebooks of writing and drawing spontaneously combusting, as well as smoking crucifixes or statues of Mary. The latest report from our agents indicates the presence of a new entity, named the Wisp.
Its appearance and behavior have been deemed appropriate for beginner exorcists, but be careful! It can be somewhat irritable, especially when exorcists interfere with lights.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40514161/d98429912adf4a419ed2b3686a889d32f38cfe0a.png[/img]

[i][b]-- Spectator Mode[/b][/i]
With the goal of offering new tools to players and content creators, a "Spectator" mode has been added.
Only the host of a multiplayer game can be a spectator, and thus follow the players during their missions, invisible to them. Spectators are unable to interact with objects or tools. They can simply spectate. Spectators are able to walk through doors.

[*] We've updated the appearance of the "entity hands" for the Shadow (the hands that appear on-screen when the entity has grabbed you).
[/list]

notes.title: [Public] Halloween Update - 10/23/2023
notes.content:
Hello Exorcists!

Halloween is almost here! This much-loved time is an opportunity for horror games to show what they're capable of!

Today, we are bringing both updates from the beta branch over to the main branch. This update includes a new map, a new game mode, three new possible evidences, new equipment, four new exorcism steps, Halloween-themed decorations in the hub, as well as various fixes and adjustments.

So here is the complete patch notes:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40514161/1d21155c61d06c0b5c38d73b54575661335787b2.png[/img]
[list]
[*] New Evidence: Notebook Fire - The Notebook can now catch fire when nearby some entities, and upon doing so will be evidence.
[*] New Evidence: Smoke: Crucifix - The Crucifix can now begin smoking when nearby some entities, and upon doing so will be evidence.
[*] New Evidence: Smoke: Mary Statue - The Mary Statue can now begin smoking when nearby some entities, and upon doing so will be evidence.
[*] New Map: ITALY - Catacombe Obscura - For centuries, these catacombs initially served as burial grounds for non-cremated bodies. Over time, and with the cessation of this practice, they gradually transitioned into a pilgrimage site, eventually becoming a tourist attraction. Recently, unusual paranormal phenomena have occurred while tourists were visiting this historically rich location. We specialize in addressing such enigmatic occurrences. Let us restore the peace and sanctity of this historical space.
[*] New Equipment: Glowsticks - Players can now buy a pack of glowsticks. Each package contains 4 glowsticks. The glowstick color can be changed with the "Alt Activate" key (usually 'Q' by default). These should come in handy when exploring the new underground labyrinth, or for marking important objects or locations.
[*] Multi-Entity contracts can now have up to 3 entities! Quick Multi-Entity contracts will still have 2 entities, but Full Multi-Entity contracts will now have 3! 
[*] New Exorcism Step: You may be asked to break a Tiger Eye capsule on the Dread Origin. In addition to the usual effect, a small blue flame will indicate that the Dread Origin was successfully cleansed with the capsule.
[*] New Exorcism Step: You may be asked to break a Salt capsule on the Dread Origin. In addition to the usual effect, a small blue flame will indicate that the Dread Origin was successfully cleansed with the capsule.
[*] New Exorcism Step: You may be asked to break a Holy Water capsule on the Dread Origin. In addition to the usual effect, a small blue flame will indicate that the Dread Origin was successfully cleansed with the capsule.
[*] New Exorcism Step: From now on, you may be asked to throw a Holy Water Capsule on a Burning Notebook. In addition to the usual effect, a charred appearance of the Notebook will indicate that you have successfully completed this step.
[*] Exorcism Step Modification: An entity can now simultaneously have Writing/Drawing evidence in the Book AND on a Surface (one no longer prevents the other)!
[*] Added an additional Holy Water / Tiger Eye / Salt capsule to the free equipment rack (depending on the contract type).
[*] Added a "Halloween" decoration theme to the hub !
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40514161/62e23be8838ad027c064ddb0cef27402fac16734.png[/img]
[list]

[/list]

notes.content:

It's now been two years since Ghost Exorcism INC joined your Steam libraries. We've evolved the game tremendously since its initial release on July 16, 2021. Thanks to your feedback and our team, the game is what it is today: a frightening and fun investigation and exorcism experience.

notes.title: [Public] "Multi-Entity" Update - 02/20/2023
notes.content:
Hello Exorcists!

The entire Ghost Exorcism INC team is proud to announce the public release of the "Multi-Entity" update.
We are very happy with the feedback we have had, and we have made the necessary corrections in the beta test phase. Here are the complete patchnote for this update.

The occult forces of this world have gone on the offensive. Several Ghost Exorcism INC teams around the world have reported encounters with multiple entities on location. A Fallen and a Demon? A Poltergeist and a Revenant? A Clown and a Fallen? It's chaos!

Effective immediately, a new type of contract called "Multi-Entity" is available for experienced and brave exorcists. These new contracts are sure to put you to the test. Proceed with caution; if one entity is exorcised, it will likely increase the strength and aggression of the second entity.

Fortunately, our Research & Development department has produced and tested a new technology to deal with the new double threats: the Environment Scanner. A cumbersome device that will allow you to know, by placing it near evidence or at orbs, to whom the analyzed evidence/orbs belong.

This is all accompanied by a new haunted location: "The Abandoned Farm".

This update is going live on the "public-test" beta branch, you can access it in your Steam library, by right-clicking on Ghost Exorcism INC, then Properties, then going to the Beta tab and selecting "public-test" from the drop-down menu.

Finally, we present to you the full patch notes:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40514161/1d21155c61d06c0b5c38d73b54575661335787b2.png[/img]
[list]
[*] [b]New game mode:[/b] Multi-Entity! Up to two entities (for now). The "Quick" variant is unlocked at level 65, and the "Full" variant is unlocked at level 100. Some details to mention; You can never have 2 of the same entity in one contract. When one entity is exorcised, the second entity becomes much more aggressive. MEL and Environment Scanner advised.
[*] [b]New equipment:[/b] The Environment Scanner! This device can detect Orbs, Surface Writing/Drawing, Book Writing/Drawing, Pentagrams, Infestations, and Totems. The Environment Scanner can also detect who is the owner of each. [b]Thie piece of equipment is critical for the new Multi-Entity contracts[/b].
[*] [b]New map:[/b] The Abandoned Farm (USA). A medium sized home-type map.
[*] [b]Exorcist - Full[/b] now has a chance to have two entities in the contract.
[*] [b]We've added an "Unstuck" button[/b] (in the tablet, Bug Report app). We've added this so that we can continue to investigate how we can improve player physics, while preventing players from finding themselves permanently stuck in a contract. By default, the first use of the Unstuck button requires a 5 second wait, but further use of the button will require the player to wait 30 more seconds for each additional use. We've added this time limitation to prevent players from abusing this mechanic.
[*] Updated format for contract selection, and contract preview.
[*] Updated format for contract pages in the Encyclopedia.
[*] Added Entity icons to the text in Encyclopedia summary.
[*] Added Entity icons to the tab titles in the Ghostpedia.

notes.title: [Public] "D.I.E Re-Awakening" Major Update - 09/23/2022
notes.content:
[h1]IMPORTANT:[/h1]
The game file structure has completely changed, and [b]we strongly suggest users completely re-install their game using the instructions below[/b].
If you have [b]played after February 20th, 2022[/b] (or played the beta/test), this re-installation [b]will not[/b] destroy your save file, however, if the last time you have played was [b]before February 20th, 202[/b]2, there is a [b]high risk[/b] that your save file will be reset by reinstalling the game.
[list]
[*] Uninstall the game from Steam.
[*] Delete the "Ghost Exorcism Inc" folder from: Steam\steamapps\common
[*] If there is a "Ghost Hunters Corp" folder, delete that.
[*] Open Steam > Settings > Downloads > Clear Download Cache.
[*] Re-install the game.[b]- The game may take a while to launch the first time.[/b]
[/list]
After that, there are several possibilities:
[list]
[*] After one or two minutes the game works, have fun!
[*] OR a longer wait time for your first launch, "Ghost Exorcism INC not responding" window appears, click "Wait". You should soon arrive on the home page, have fun!
[/list]
If after all that, the game starts, and soon after the window closes completely (game crash), do the following steps:
[list]
[*] Press Windows + R
[*] Paste the following text in the dialog box: C:\users\%username%\AppData\LocalLow\StudioGoupil\Ghost Exorcism Inc
[*] Press Enter
[*] https://ghostexorcisminc.com/public/help/Gex0000.setting
Download the file at this address, and place it in the folder you've just opened (replace the file if needed).
[*] Launch the game.
[/list]
Do not hesitate to send an email to the address: bug@ghostexorcisminc.com or join the official Discord ( copy and paste this into your browser - https://discord.gg/sMEmq5br9z ) and open a support ticket if none of these instructions helped you solve your problem.

[h1]UPDATES & ADDITIONS[/h1]
[b][u]Localization & Voice[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] You are welcome to help us translate the game by visiting our Google Sheets link, and following the instructions: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1XhVjDVFWeQUeMsVzdduRHk55qq9vRneKlBo0PAuf5oo/edit#gid=0
[/list]

[b][u]Core Changes/Additions to Gameplay Mechanics[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] The Crucifix and the Mary statue no longer completely stop entities in their tracks. They will instead be heavily slowed when near these pieces of equipment. The Mary Statue still only works while it is on the ground, and the Crucifix can still work from both the ground, and while held.
[*] Speaking to the entity to gather evidence such as Book Writing/Book Drawing, Spirit-Box, Voice-On-Site, and reciting the Exorcism Book now must all be done while standing in the Orbs of the Dread Origin, or while very close to the entity.
[*] Entity attacks now function differently. Previously, entities would attack you- and if they got close enough, they would cause a "wavy screen" effect until it eventually killed you. With the new update, an entities attack is signified by a "horror drone" sound effect. The entity will chase you, and when it catches you, it will immediately cause an injury to you, or worse.
[*] Players can now be harmed via injuries, or via heart attacks. If a player is harmed by a heart attack, they will notice a flash of grey on their screen before they fall over unconscious.
[/list]

[b][u]Core Changes/Additions to Systems[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] There is now a multiplayer lobby list system (in addition to the previous code-based system). Players can now select a regional server, and look for public lobbies in that region.
[*] The in-game Bug Report app, as well as the Suggestions are now fully implemented. Players are welcome to submit bug reports or suggestions from in-game, with very little effort. The Bug Report app is in the tablet homepage, and the Suggestions can be found in the Game Info app.
[*] There is now a spawn-limit for equipment. Players can see how many pieces of equipment are currently spawned VS how many are allowed to be spawned by simply looking at the computer in the vehicle, and selecting a piece of equipment. This spawn limit is NOT for balancing purposes, but instead, is for security purposes for public lobbies.
[*] There are now player-statistics! The statistics are available in the Statistics app, or can be seen on the main board in the Hub, before selecting a contract.
[/list]

[b][u]Other Additions[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] Dolls :)
[/list]

[b][u]Ghost AI, Behavior and Appearance[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] New entity type: Memory. A "mostly" harmless entity that can be tricky to spot and track.
[*] The Shadow entity has been overhauled. Shadows are now literally just that... a shadow! They are invisible to players and cameras, unless exposed to direct light (or flashlight). They are an entirely invisible entity, but when illuminated, still casts a shadow.
[*] One of the previous "Fallen" models are now used as a Demon model. This was done to make room for more entity models in the future.
[*] A large amount of new entity interactions have been added. TV interactions, new light interactions, new floating object interactions (and more).
[*] There are now more interactions an entity can have on a player. Some of these interactions include "Push" and "Disarm".
[/list]

[b][u]User Interface[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] In multiplayer, players can now adjust the volume of their teammates microphones in the "My Team" tab.
[*] Players who are the Host of a lobby can kick other players out of the lobby.
[*] There is an all-new Encyclopedia app, which contains extremely useful information for players. If you want to learn how to identify an entity, or want more specific details about equipment, this is the app for you!
[*] Maps are now purchasable from inside of the Encyclopedia app, as well as from the Ghost Market.
[/list]

[b][u]Equipment[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] New Equipment: Revival Kits (that can be used on downed teammates to revive them). Players who are playing multiplayer can be revived a maximum of 1 time per contract. No more than 3 total Revival Kits can be used in any given contract.
[*] New Equipment: Refreshing Beverage. The Refreshing Beverage can be consumed to heal injuries, or lower the players heart rate.
[*] The Salt Shotgun is now the Modified Shotgun - it can now fire both Tiger Eye projectiles, as well as Salt projectiles.
[*] The Neutrino-Gun now has a camera mounted on the top of it. This can be used to see invisible objects/entities like any other camera.
[*] The Photo Camera can now detect, and display (in text) what it is looking at (entities, surface writing, totems, book drawing, etc)
[*] Both video cameras have been given upgrades in the form of information in the vehicle. If an entity is spotted by a camera (from the CCTV monitor in the vehicle), exorcism information will be displayed on the board next to the monitor.
[*] The Occult Meter now has a "Area" and "Multiple Signals" light. When the "Area" light is ON, this means that the cursed object (or Totem) is in the same room/area. When the "Multiple Signals" light is ON, this means that there are multiple cursed objects detected.
[*] Holy Water, Tiger Eye, and Salt capsules, if broken on the ground, will function as a permanent trap in that location (until they are stepped on by an entity). When the Tiger Eye or Salt trap is stepped on, it will turned dark grey. When the Holy Water is stepped on, the "wet floor" effect will vanish.
[/list]

[b][u]Tutorial[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] We've added a full interactive tutorial mission/location! While playing solo, from the Hub you can begin the tutorial at any time.
[/list]

[b][u]Graphics & Performance[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] Many adjustments were made to improve performance on most machines.
[*] We have completely overhauled the lighting, shadows, and rendering on all maps.
[*] We have added new graphics options (such as Depth of Field).
[*] We've added a Windowed Mode option, and a Borderless Fullscreen option.
[*] We now have a proper VSync option available in the game, and we strongly advise most people to use it, unless you are confident with your technical skills/computers.
[/list]

[h1]BUG FIXES[/h1]
[b][u]"The Important Ones"[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] The "mouse lag" or "frame skips" which caused the players view to suddenly jump around has been fixed.
[*] The "broken hands" bug should be entirely fixed.
[*] Broken doors (kickflipping doors) should be entirely fixed.
[*] Multiplayer desync problems should be mostly resolved, as we've changed to an entirely new multiplayer network system.
[/list]

[b][u]Other Resolved Bugs[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] We've re-coded the entire game from the ground-up. Along this 6+ month process, we've found and fixed nearly 1,000 bugs. There are simply too many to note here.

notes.title: [Public Test] Major update "Ghost Exorcism INC 2.0" - 08/24/2022
notes.content:
Hello Exorcists! 

We thank you for your patience over the past few months! Here are the [b]some[/b] of the big changes in complete overhaul of Ghost Exorcism INC.
Don't forget, we have more planned for Halloween! ^^

[b]To join the public test: Right-click on Ghost Exorcism INC. in Steam -> Properties -> Betas -> Then make sure you have the Public Test Build version selected in the list, then allow the game to update.[/b]

[h1]MULTIPLAYER NOTE:[/h1]
[b]During the public beta testing, multiplayer lobbies will be restricted to 2 players! This is only temporary during the testing phase, as we are still optimizing the multiplayer network for 6 players![/b]

[h1]UPDATES & ADDITIONS[/h1]
[b][u]Localization & Voice[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] Most of the language in the game has been re-written. This means that for now, the game will be available in English and in French. We plan to add more languages soon! You can help us translate the game by visiting our Google Sheets link, and following the instructions: [url=https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1XhVjDVFWeQUeMsVzdduRHk55qq9vRneKlBo0PAuf5oo/edit#gid=0]our translations page (google document)[/url]
[/list]

[b][u]Core Changes/Additions to Gameplay Mechanics[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] The Crucifix and the Mary statue no longer completely stop entities in their tracks. They will instead be heavily slowed when near these pieces of equipment. The Mary Statue still only works while it is on the ground, and the Crucifix can still work from both the ground, and while held.
[*] Speaking to the entity to gather evidence such as Book Writing/Book Drawing, Spirit-Box, Voice-On-Site, and reciting the Exorcism Book must all be done while standing in the Orbs of the Dread Origin, or while very close to the entity.
[*] Entity attacks now function differently. Previously, entities would attack you- and if they got close enough, they would cause a "wavy screen" effect until it eventually killed you. With the new update, an entities attack is signified by a "horror drone" sound effect. The entity will chase you, and when it catches you, it will immediately cause an injury to you, or worse.
[*] Players can now be harmed via injuries, or via heart attacks. If a player is harmed by a heart attack, they will notice a flash of grey on their screen before they fall over unconscious.
[/list]

[b][u]Core Changes/Additions to Systems[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] There is now a multiplayer lobby list system (in addition to the previous code-based system). Players can now select a regional server, and look for public lobbies in that region.
[*] The in-game Bug Report app, as well as the Suggestions are now fully implemented. Players are welcome to submit bug reports or suggestions from in-game, with very little effort. The Bug Report app is in the tablet homepage, and the Suggestions can be found in the Game Info app.
[*] There is now a spawn-limit for equipment. Players can see how many pieces of equipment are currently spawned VS how many are allowed to be spawned by simply looking at the computer in the vehicle, and selecting a piece of equipment. This spawn limit is NOT for balancing purposes, but instead, is for security purposes for public lobbies.
[*] There are now player-statistics! The statistics are available in the Statistics app, or can be seen on the main board in the Hub, before selecting a contract.
[/list]

[b][u]Other Additions[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] Dolls :)
[/list]

[b][u]Ghost AI, Behavior and Appearance[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] New entity type: Memory. A mostly harmless entity that can be tricky to spot and track.
[*] The Shadow entity has been overhauled. Shadows are now literally just that... a shadow! They are invisible to players and cameras, unless exposed to direct light (or flashlight). They are an entirely invisible entity, but when illuminated, still casts a shadow.
[*] One of the previous "Fallen" models are now used as a Demon model. This was done to make room for more entity models in the future.
[*] A large amount of new entity interactions have been added. TV interactions, new light interactions, new floating object interactions (and more).
[*] There are now more interactions an entity can have on a player. Some of these interactions include "Push" and "Disarm".
[/list]

[b][u]User Interface[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] In multiplayer, players can now adjust the volume of their teammates microphones in the "My Team" tab.
[*] Players who are the Host of a lobby can kick other players out of the lobby.
[*] There is an all-new Encyclopedia app, which contains extremely useful information for players. If you want to learn how to identify an entity, or want more specific details about equipment, this is the app for you!
[*] Maps are now purchaseable from inside of the Encyclopedia app.
[/list]

[b][u]Equipment[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] New Equipment: Revival Kits (that can be used on downed teammates to revive them). Players who are playing multiplayer can be revived a maximum of 1 time per contract. No more than 3 total Revival Kits can be used in any given contract.
[*] New Equipment: Refreshing Beverage. The Refreshing Beverage can be consumed to heal injuries, or lower the players heart rate.
[*] The Salt Shotgun is now the Modified Shotgun - it can now fire both Tiger Eye projectiles, as well as Salt projectiles.
[*] The Neutrino-Gun now has a camera mounted on the top of it. This can be used to see invisible objects/entities like any other camera.
[*] The Photo Camera can now detect, and display (in text) what it is looking at (entities, surface writing, totems, book drawing, etc)
[*] Both video cameras have been given upgrades in the form of information in the vehicle. If an entity is spotted by a camera (from the CCTV monitor in the vehicle), exorcism information will be displayed on the board next to the monitor.
[*] The Occult Meter now has a "Area" and "Multiple Signals" light. When the "Area" light is ON, this means that the cursed object (or Totem) is in the same room. When the "Multiple Signals" light is ON, this means that there are multiple cursed objects detected.
[*] Holy Water, Tiger Eye, and Salt capsules, if broken on the ground, will function as a permanent trap in that location (until they are stepped on by an entity). When the Tiger Eye or Salt trap is stepped on, it will turned dark grey. When the Holy Water is stepped on, the "wet floor" effect will vanish.
[/list]

[b][u]Gameplay & Balance[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] We've added a full interactive tutorial mission/location! While playing solo, from the Hub you can begin the tutorial at any time.
[*] The "Bamboo Temple" map in Japan has been completely rework, in order to better reflect the vision of a traditional Japanese temple.
[/list]

[b][u]Graphics & Performance[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] Many adjustments were made to improve performance on most machines.
[*] We have completely overhauled the lighting, shadows, and rendering on all maps.
[*] We have added new graphics options (such as Depth of Field).
[*] We've added a Windowed Mode option, and a Borderless Fullscreen option.
[*] We now have a proper VSync option available in the game.
[/list]

[list]
[*] The "broken hands" bug should be entirely fixed.
[*] Broken doors (kickflipping doors) should be entirely fixed.
[*] Multiplayer desync should be resolved, as we've changed to an entirely new multiplayer network system.
[/list]

[b][u]Other Resolved Bugs[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] We've re-coded the entire game from the ground-up. Along this 5+ month process, we've found and fixed nearly 1,000 bugs. There are simply too many to note here.
[*] Please note, since this has been re-coded, we still expect bugs to be found and reported. The game is going through a beta phase for exactly this reason. Please do not hesitate to report bugs you find using the in-game Bug Report app.

Next, we're going to talk about entity attacks, and how they are able to damage exorcists. Before now, if the entity was chasing you, and caught you - you had the time limit of a wavy screen to indicate that you were about to be injured. In the coming beta, however- an entity will chase you until it catches you. Once it catches you, you will sustain an injury, or worse. Exorcists who go "to the other side" will still have the ability to decide whether or not to help their teammates. We've tried to make entity attacks a little less punishing by changing the way we think.
We therefore present a new feature: Disorientation.
Once the entity grabs you, it can cause damage to your psyche and can potentially transport you to any location of its choosing. You will be in shock and will not be able to run or carry an item in your off-hand.

[i]"You thought you could escape me, exorcist!? That's not gonna happen!"[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40514161/c9a481e2d0c844fb9ccc814f79ebddf0fea0e3cf.gif[/img]

- Return to the vehicle, and while in the safety of the vehicle, you'll feel better after a few seconds.
- You can also opt for one of the new equipment in this update: the Refreshing Drink! It will heal your wounds, allow you to run again, and carry an item in each hand. HQ strongly suggest that wary or unfamiliar exorcists carry one on their belt at all times ^^.

[i]Due to a recent study conducted at our Ghost Exorcism INC offices, we learned that a simple Refreshing Drink could cure stress and mental shock caused by entity attacks![/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40514161/64438aa652be3d956769e0576963047061d98590.png[/img]

We are thinking about everything regarding this overhaul update. Moreover, we strongly questioned one aspect: the Crucifix and the Statue of Mary. We noticed for quite some time that their use was far too beneficial and we therefore made decisions to modify their use.
Previously (in the current game) these tools acted as a barrier/shield that stopped certain types of entities. After the update arrives, these tools will no longer stop entities in their tracks; it will considerably slow them down instead. The slowing strength of these tools will be substantial and strong.
We'll be updating the Door Barrier feature to be more consistent, and strong. Instead of being forced to stand at the door, holding it closed - exorcists will now be able to close the door until it "clicks" closed, then continue running for their lives.

And what about you? Is there a feature you would like to see when the overhaul comes out?

notes.title: Devblog - 05/11/2022
notes.content:
Hello Exorcists!

We're back with another “Letter from the Developers” to talk to you and show you what we're working on right now.

We are quite happy with the progress of the work for this important update, with, as always the goal of offering you the best experience of hunting supernatural entities.

We have read your feedback in emails, in the Steam comments, as well as in Discord- and we will clarify a number of points regarding the future new progression system:

[b][i]"What exactly will it consist of?"[/i][/b]
You will earn experience and money as you complete contracts, from objectives/secondary objectives, from photos you take, and from occult items you bring back to the HQ after a contract. With the experience and money accumulated, you will unlock a certain number of elements.

[b][i]"Why do entities unlock with levels?"[/i][/b]
In order to allow new players to discover the game and progress at their own pace and to avoid them having to fight an entity that is too aggressive in their first game. We are also thinking of more experienced players, who have been able to improve their approach to the various contracts and locations. We want them to be able to easily visualize their progression in the game, and give them even more ways to be proud of progressing.

[b][i]"But, maps are also unlocked at high levels?"[/i][/b]
No, the maps are unlocked with the money you earn as you complete the missions. Why? To encourage players to discover the maps, to give new or updated maps a fair chance, to try different approaches or methods, but also to master the purchase of equipment, so players are less incentivized to buy dozens of copies of an item. Instead, we can begin developing the process for players to start spending in-game money elsewhere. In conclusion, we want a second wind and a new interest with in-game money. You should also know that it will not take a lot of money to unlock each map. This is hopefully just the beginning of purchasable unlocks, we hope to add more options/new content to be purchasable and unlocked with in-game money in the near future.

[b][i]"But... until now we could play on all maps, with all entities. What is the point of restricting now on already existing data?"[/i][/b]
Well... Ghost Exorcism INC is in Early Access, the gameplay has always been changing, evolving, and improving, that's what we strive to accomplish. Moreover, it would indeed be of little interest if there were no further additions in the the update, which will not be the case! ;)

[b][i]"We're going to lose our save and have to start all over again?"[/i][/b]
The save system is getting a slight overhaul. In view of the first tests, players will keep the money they have accumulated, regarding experience, since we will change the experience necessary to level up, players will keep the experience they have accumulated until they reach a capped ceiling corresponding to the "new" level 40. This will allow players not to feel a "waste" of time, but also to have content to discover despite their high level. To boil it down; those of you who were very high level before, will still be very high level in the new XP system. The new system has different scaling, and different thresholds, so your level may not be a perfect mirror of what it is currently in-game, and this is intended.

[b][i]"A progression system, sure, why not... but if it's still so difficult to navigate when you're new, it will be useless."[/i][/b]
Well precisely! A map specifically designed to be an interactive tutorial is in development and will arrive with the update. You will be able to learn how to use the different game objects in a live-action way.

[b][i]"So this is more than a graphics and lighting update?"[/i][/b]
Yes!! At this stage, we can speak of a real overhaul and improvement of the game. You will know more about it in the next announcement!

[b][i]"When is this huge update coming?" "Any ETA?"[/i][/b]
We will be able to give you a date in the next announcement we post. Stay tuned!

We hope to have answered most of your questions!

As we've previously mentioned, we have many elements that we would like to integrate into Ghost Exorcism INC. in order to improve the gaming experience.

[list]
[*]We are studying the integration of an additional variant of the Salt Shotgun. Indeed, the fact that our current option is only “two shots” is quite disabling when we see that it greatly restricts the possibilities of the players (the shotgun being held with two hands).
[*]We are thinking about integrating a real progression system with respect to your experience and the levels you gain, and rewards to be unlocked in "stages". Different and much more robust than our current game progression.

notes.title: [IMPORTANT] Name change
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Already 7 months ago, we released our game, and you welcomed it with such enthusiasm. It warmed our hearts.

4 months ago, we grew up and officially announced the creation of StudioGoupil, with a change of logo, graphic charter, font, and so on.
This evolution has proven that we have grown with you, and it's you we thank for it.

Today, we are taking a new step to go beyond what we were at the launch, by changing the name of the game.
From now on, the game developed by StudioGoupil is called [b][u]Ghost Exorcism Inc[/u][/b]!


[b]UPDATE[/b]
Following popular demand from players in our Discord, here are the details about the name change:
[list]
[*] The first reason is a legal one. Another company asked us to change our name, so after months of reflection (and being a very small studio), we decided to change.
[*] The game has always been more than an investigation game, and the new name is an opportunity to set ourselves apart and to remind players that you are here to [i]exorcise[/i] entities. We will continue to evolve it in this direction.
[*] Some noted that the new acronym is different, it's true. We looked for other solutions but the word 'Ghost' was important to us and we didn't want to get rid of it. Whether you choose to use GEx, GEI, GExInc or something else, we know the community will make the game their own, and for that we are eternally grateful.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40514161/592eecad24e9c2783a94ff82a5bcdd773b73ee13.png[/img]

notes.title: [Beta] Update & Bug Fixes 2022.01.05
notes.content:
Hello Exorcists,

We're starting this new year with a big update, with lots of additions and changes. Our desire has always been and will always be the improvement of the gaming experience, and for that we have prepared some little surprises, as well as: a new map, functional and graphic UI update, an area outside the van to deposit corrupted items, lots of bug fixes, and finally... public lobbies.

[b][u]This update is sent on the "public pre-prod" version. To access it, in your Steam library, right click on Ghost Hunters Corp, then Ownership. In the beta tab, select the "public pre-prod" version[/u][/b]
[b]*[/b] HotFixed: Korean language updated. People who use Korean language can now see the Public Lobby option.

[h1]UPDATES & ADDITIONS[/h1]
[b][u]Languages[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] Several languages have had several additions and updates.
[*] Any non-translated text will appear in the game as English. Some text may be translated with Google Translate. If you wish to submit language corrections, or translations, please do so by emailing:
contact@ghosthunterscorp.com
[/list]

[b][u]Multiplayer & Network[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] We have added public lobbies! You can now create public lobbies, or join lobbies from your own country, your own continent, or worldwide if you prefer.
[*] Now, only the lobby Host will be able to select a contract/map. If you are a Client, you will see a different contract board, which will include some information for you to look at while you wait for the lobby Host to select a contract.
[/list]

[b][u]Systems[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] We've added a random variable to the Free Contract selection board, so that the list of free contracts will no longer become perfectly syncronized with each other.
[/list]

[b][u]Maps & Generation[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] A new map has been added: Sweden - Family Home
A small-medium map designed for 1 to 3 players.
Has a creepy basement. You can check the basement, I'll stay up top.
[*] We've adjusted Barony's Map Bonus. You will now have a very small payment bonus for completing contracts in the Barony.
[/list]

[b][u]Ghost AI & Behavior[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] We've given the Child Entity type a voice ;)
(Ghostly Voice On-Site)
[/list]

[b][u]User Interface[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] We've completely overhauled the Contract board in the lobby. It now correctly matches the theme of the Tablet and computer in the vehicle. The new contract board will now always show Extreme contracts with a red outline, to prevent misclicking contracts you did not mean to select or buy. The contract board will now show icons/thumbnails for each and every map, as well as a much easier to understand visual "contract bonus system" which can will allow players to see the map-size bonus at a glance. The post-game contract board will now show you the correct evidence, as well as which evidence you incorrectly selected.
[/list]

[b][u]Gameplay & Balance[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] Made minor adjustments to the economy of contracts. Very light nerf to Simple Long and Simple Short contract currency rewards. (we promise, the nerf is hardly even noticeable)
[*] Adjusted the price of photos. On either difficulty, photos in most categories will reward 10 currency. Photos of ghosts will reward 20. In general, this is a buff to the camera/photo rewards. Additional photos of the same type will reward a small percentage of the original value.
[*] We've made significant changes to the way experience is earned in the game. In a similar manner to the economy overhaul, we've adjusted all experience gains to more appropriately match the work and investment of the player. Collecting accurate evidence is now the most effective way to gain experience. Exorcising the entity still provides a large bonus to xp, and is critical to gaining all of the earned experience, without a penalty. Overall, players will earn the same experience on Simple Short contracts, but considerably more experience on Extreme Short, and a lot more on Extreme Long contracts. (there was a bug causing Extreme Short missions to give the same experience as Simple Long missions, this has been fixed, and adjusted). Extreme Short will now give about 45% more XP than previously, and Extreme Long will now give about 50% more XP than previously.
[*] Players will no longer lose the XP they've gathered before fainting/being knocked out, regardless of if the body was returned to the vehicle. This does not apply to currency. Currency is still lost upon fainting. You will now always keep the XP you've earned.
[*] We've added a "Deposit Zone" outside of the vehicle (to the rear, or side), so that while you're in a contract/mission, you can easily deposit cursed objects (or even equipment you wish to bring back to base, if you choose to abandon the mission). This zone should make it a lot easier to manage large-sized cursed objects. Simply drop any items you wish to bring back to HQ anywhere on the platform, inside of the lightposts.
[*] We've added a few additional incense sticks to the free/starter item pool on the shelves for Simple Difficulty contracts.
Free of charge ;)"
[*] We have rebalanced level requirements and prices for almost all equipment in the game. The previous level requirements were simply placeholders until we completed the XP and Economy overhaul. For all exact level/price changes, see this page:
[url=https://swift-zoo-a70.notion.site/UI-Contract-Board-Update-23fbfe945441404cb758a6e44188f909]Notion: The Economy Changes[/url]
[/list]

[b][u]Equipment[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] The Crucifix and the Mary Statue will now slightly glow in dark enviornments, so players will always be aware if the defensive tools are destroyed or not. They will also slightly glow (when they are still active/healthy) in the Night Vision camera.
[*] Large equipment (the High-Def Camera, the Threat Detector, the Tripod Spotlight) will now spawn outside of the vehicle, on the new new 'Deposit Zone'. The Salt Shotgun will now spawn on the vehicle floor (same location as the Neutrino-Gun) This will help prevent clutter in the vehicle. (can we get a moment of silence for the legendary 'hallway of tripod spotlights'?)
[*] The Occult Meter has been overhauled. It will now signal if it detects Corrupt objects (the objects to destroy for exorcism). If you bring it within close proximity of a corrupt object, the face of the Occult Meter will pulse a red color. This is in additional to it's previous purpose of detecting normal cursed objects. The Occult Meter is now a starter/free item given to players during Simple Difficulty contracts.
[*] The Thermometer has been added to the free/starter items given to players during Simple Difficulty contracts.
[*] The MEL has been removed from the starter/free items which are given to players during Simple Difficulty contracts. This has been deemed a "high tier" piece of equipment, which is capable of doing the job of up to 4 other pieces of equipment all on it's own. Also, because of this, the MEL's price and level requirement has been increased.
[*] Tiger Eye textures and object shapes have been updated. On the free/starter Tiger Eye given to players, the object shape has been updated to allow a more consistant hitbox. This will help when throwing the stone at the entity. The "used" Tiger Eye texture has been updated to look slightly less like a grey blob.
[/list]

[h1]BUG FIXES[/h1]
[b][u]Equipment[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] Salt has been fixed! Salt did not interact correctly with the entity when it was thrown by hand. Salt will now trigger the appropriate effects if the salt contacts the entities body. Salt only works on entities which require salt to be exorcised. (no more throwing salt at ghostly feet! It's the small victories that feel the best, sometimes)
[*] Tiger Eye stone has been fixed! There was a bug which made it very difficult to throw the stone at the entity (and hit it) with the Tiger Eye. This has been fixed, and now players who hit the entity on any part of its body will now trigger the appropriate effect. It's important to remember, Tiger Eye stones and Salt only work on entities which require them to be exorcised, Also worth remembering: The "free" Tiger Eye stones are smaller in size, and have a smaller hitbox than the "paid/premium" tiger eye stones.
[*] The Thermometer has been fixed! Previously, players would only be able to get the ER.0 message by aiming the thermometer at the entities feet. This has been fixed, and players can now aim the thermometer anywhere on the entities body to get the ER.0 message.
NOTE: The entity must be VISIBLE to the player while making the scan in order to get the ER.0 message."
[*] The Instant Camera (the free one given to players during Simple Difficulty missions) has been fixed. It was supposed to give players 3 charges/flashes, but it was only giving 2.
[*] Photos will no longer stack rewards! Previously, the XP and Currency reward per photo stacked infinitely, meaning you could photograph the same circumstance over and over to get an absurdly high photo reward. Now, photos will give you one large correct payout per subject, then all further photos of that subject will give 1/3 of the original reward.
[/list]

[b][u]Ghost AI & Behavior[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] (Demon Laugh / Ghostly Voice on Site) Several instances of Demon laughter not triggering when it was supposed to have been fixed. In testing, all Ghostly Voice On-Site evidence now appears to function as intended (though changes may be coming in the future to help players understand the difference between Ghostly Voice evidence, and general ghostly screams, or aggression).
PLEASE NOTE: To get Ghostly Voice On-Site evidence (which includes Demon Laugh), the player must be in close proximity to the entity when requesting it to speak. Roughly the same proximity as an MEL device. A Spirit-Box is NOT required to get this evidence, however using a Spirit-Box when making vocal requests to the entity can increase the chances the entity will speak back to you.
[/list]

[b][u]User Interface[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed the circular experience bar, next to your avatar in the menu/tablet. It should now appropriately fill the circle as you become closer to leveling up!
[/list]

[b][u]Maps & Generation[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] (St. Samael) We have corrected a massive door-gap that was upstairs next to the hallway bookshelf.
[*] (Lost House) We have fixed the art set (immediately inside of the house, in the room to the right, next to the painting easel). When this object was cursed, it used to require a camera flash to be picked up or moved, even if the object was already visible.
[*] (Lost House) There was a problem which broke all footstep sounds in Lost House. We have fixed this- so you should be able to hear yourself walking in the house again. We never intended for the players footstep sounds to be the phantom.
[*] (Cemetary) We have fixed many gravestones so that they are no longer stacked inside of each other.
[*] (Barony) The vines to the right of the entrance are now in contact with the wall.
[*] (Camp) The vehicle's headlights are now connected to the vehicle properly.
[/list]

[b][u]Multiplayer & Network[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] We've mostly fixed a bug which can cause players to enter different maps at the same time (or be in two different instances of the same map at the same time). There will now be up to a 5 second delay after clicking the steering wheel (to start a contract) before the vehicle starts. This 5 second delay is used to give the User Clients time to automatically update to the Host's map selection (in case they have high latency, or a poor internet connection). If a Client or Host has severe ping or lag, it is still theoretically possible to go into two seperate maps at the same time, or experience other very strange desync issues. We will try to create a more complete fix at a later date.

[b][u]Systems[/u][/b]

[/list]

notes.content:
Hello Exorcists !

We're back with the second edition of the DevBlog. Here is some of what is to come soon...

Let's start with Public Lobbies! We're excited to announce that we're close to publishing this update! We know players around the world have wanted this for a long time, and we continue to work hard on making this a reality. We have no exact date for this update yet, but rest assured, Public Lobbies are planned, and are nearly ready.
With Public Lobbies, you'll be able to join or create lobbies from only your country, only your continent, or even worldwide if you prefer. The choice will be yours. We hope you will enjoy this!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40514161/f8df6aaa8b024999e596c2a6b1d2064417bfaf05.png[/img]

We have a (very wonderful looking) update of the Contract Board in the lobby. The update will bring the Contract Board and its theme up to date with the Tablet interface, and the vehicle computer interface. The new post-game contract board will have some information that was previously unavailable, such as; The map you played, the difficulty you were on, the correct (and incorrect) evidence selections, a much cleaner display of how much XP and money you've gained, and a much cleaner way to display which side-objectives you've completed or did not complete.

We have realized that the MEL was particularly powerful, which left other equipment heavily underused. The MEL did the job of 3 or 4 pieces of equipment.
For this reason, we have removed the MEL from the free/starter equipment which is given to players (on the shelf) on Simple Contracts. You can still purchase the item from the Ghost Market to use anywhere at your own leisure.
Because of the power of the MEL, we have increased it's level requirement, and cost. https://swift-zoo-a70.notion.site/Public-UI-Contract-Board-Update-23fbfe945441404cb758a6e44188f909

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40514161/ea3a8772c35e26f10ba6f8f61f08de8261dcb518.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40514161/6551da83f7dad68672465e2beb33c0ebffc33ab2.png[/img]

We also plan to release a new small-medium sized map. A modern home, with a very unsettling basement.

Do not forget your Crucifixes and your Mary Statues!

notes.title: Update & bugs correction 2021.11.19
notes.content:
Hello Exorcists !

Since the Halloween update, we've been fixing some issues, including one big flaw that we believe is making Ghost Hunters Corp a bit off balance : the economy. We have therefore worked to readjust the economy based on several factors, described below.

[h1]UPDATES & ADDITIONS[/h1]
[b][u]Languages[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] Japanese has had many corrections and additions. Special thanks to "参謀 さ ん Ｐ （： ３）"
[*] Russian language and vocal file have been adjusted and updated.
[*] Chinese language has been updated.
[*] Any non-translated text will appear in the game as English. If you wish to submit language corrections, or translations, please do so by emailing:
contact@ghosthunterscorp.com"
[/list]

[b][u]Systems[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] Made several changes to debug logs which should make it easier for us to diagnose issues in the game.
[/list]

[b][u]Maps & Generation[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] (Fort) We have removed some hideous rocks in the courtyard area that seemed to ignore the laws of the universe. We are glad they're gone.
[/list]

[b][u]User Interface[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] (Multiplayer) Players will now have information in their tablet when connected as both a Client and as a Host.
[/list]

[b][u]Gameplay & Balance[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] We are aware that it can be very difficult to bring your teammates unconcious body back to the vehicle due to a few different issues. For now, we will allow all players on death (no matter the situation) to earn 20% of the money they would have earned. Hopefully this will alleviate the problems a bit, while we work on building a new system which will cause players to drop a "Soul-Jar"-like object upon fainting. Bringing this object back to the vehicle will be what rewards the unconcious players with their 50% earnings. Once this new system is prepared, and released, we will remove the global 20% return on money, and return to a 0% income gain upon fainting.
"[*] We have made very significant changes to the overall economy of contracts.
We fully intend for players to be able to exorcise the entities without gathering any evidence. This was originally to allow player freedom, however we have noticed that players who ARE exorcising the entities, and playing the game in a more complete fashion aren't being rewarded as much as we'd like.
With this information, we have made changes to how much players will earn from gathering accurate evidence, as well as correct categorzation of the entity.
The changes will much more heavily favor players who gather and enter correct evidence, as well as exorcise the entity. Previously, between 15-25% of your income was based on correct evidence collection. This has changed, and evidence collection now makes up about 50-60% of total income from a contract.
Please note, every game difficulty, both Short and Long contracts will reward considerably more money in total- but we've also adjusted the old placeholder penalties to be more hard-hitting, and costly.
We plan to adjust the economy as we move forward, but we feel that these changes will reward players with even more money, even higher risks, and lean toward evidence gathering, rather than just spam-exorcising the entity, then leaving."
[/list]

[b][u]Multiplayer & Network[/u][/b]

[*] Added a confirmation window before disconnecting from a lobby.
[/list]

[b][u]Equipment[/u][/b]

[*] Scrolling your mouse (while dragging an item) will no longer cause your to switch items. We are also aware of a bug at the vehicle computer which will cause you to scroll through your held items while scrolling through the vehicle inventory. We're working to fix this one as well.
[*] "Aggression Indicator" is now appropriately called a "Threat Detector".
[*] Bug fix : The tutorial camera does not have panel buttons, and the screen shows the wrong camera.
[/list]

[b][u]User Interface[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] The UI in the Multiplayer "Lobby" tab was being crushed from a UI bug. That's been fixed.
[/list]

[h1]BUG FIXES[/h1]
[b][u]Equipment[/u][/b]

notes.title: Patchnote 08.18.2021
notes.content:
Hello Ghost Hunters !

This is an update we couldn't wait to bring you. Several fixes and changes have been made, as well as significant additions.

The most important addition in this update concerns hunting maps. We've been telling you a week ago, but here are three new maps where you can exorcise supernatural entities:
- The Barony of Günther in Germany.
- The cemetery of the last rest in Pennsylvania.
- The Bamboo temple in Japan.

But that's not all ! A private lobby system has been set up : once in the hub, all you have to do is open your tablet, enter the Multiplayer application, create a lobby and share the code that appears so a player just have to copy it into the Multiplayer application, and it will join your lobby.
Moreover, you were expecting it, ingame vocals are now available ! When you join a lobby, you will be able to speak directly in the game, you will also have the possibility of completely mute yourself (for others players, and for entity), as well as deactivating the voice which is activated by default for a better immersion in game. Finally, a walkie talkie is now in your backpack, you just have to press the key that you have configured so that your teammates can hear you from anywhere on the map.

Two weeks of development to be able to offer you the best in the best conditions, and that also involves gameplay modifications.

Starting with the difficulty levels. You will now have the choice between four difficulty modes:
- Simple investigation - short : 2 to 3 proofs maximum to find, no "complex" exorcism, a difficulty mainly based on the investigation. Available at level 0.
- Simple investigation - long : 3 to 5 proofs maximum to find, possibility of "complex" exorcism, a difficulty mainly based on the investigation. Available at level 5.
- Extreme Investigation - short : 2 to 3 proofs maximum to find, no "complex" exorcism, without starting equipment but with a bonus of xp / money, a big difficulty with an entity that only wants one thing, incapacitate yourself before you do. Available at level 10.
- Extreme investigation - long : 3 to 5 proofs maximum to find, possibility of "complex" exorcism, without starting equipment but with a bonus of xp / money, a big difficulty with an entity which wants only one thing, incapacitate yourself before you do. Available at level 15.

Then comes the modification of the end-of-mission dashboard, more fluid, with more information to keep you in touch with what you have done well or poorly.

We have readjusted and reactivated the possibility for the entity to get angry and to send in all directions the defense objects (Crucifix and Statue of Mary) if there are three or more within a radius of 5 meters when the entity decides to attack you.

Since the module used for ingame speech recognition requires it, we have changed the use of the exorcism book. From now on, each sentence must be pronounced one after the other, leaving a space between each sentence, the time it is analyzed and validated by the game. You will easily see it with the text which turns gray once a sentence has been validated.

The entity's AI has also undergone some adjustments ! From now on, at the start of the mission, the entity will wander around the entire area, and will only be able to become aggressive when you have found and approached it. Indeed, at the beginning of the game, the entity doesn't know that you are there and you will have to meet it so that it decides to show itself afterwards.
The entity will react in a slightly different way as the game progresses : the more you go through the exorcism steps, the more the entity will become unpredictable and hostile.
Finally, when it is subject to the effect of an exorcism object, the entity will teleport randomly to one of the different points provided for it.

Finally, we changed some settings and their visibilities. Other options (graphics, sounds, microphone, etc.) will be added over time.

Regarding fixes and debugging, here is a non-exhaustive list:
- Fixed several issues with desynchronization between players.
- Fixed automatic write sound that would trigger when visually the entity had not written anything.
- Fixed a host / client desynchronization problem related to the Spirit box.
- Fixed a phenomenon that caused orbs in the Haunting Room to float when the exorcism was finished.
- Fixed an issue with the multiplication and desynchronization of camera photos.
- Fixed a bug where a "Ghost" photo is validated when the entity is not in view.
- Fixed a framing issue in the player death animation.
- A problem related to the microphone can occur if you use a virtual sound card software, do not hesitate to go to the Steam forum or to the discord, you will find a simple manipulation allowing its resolution.
- Range of the instant camera increased.
- Slight increase in the detection of the Spirit-box by the entity (from 4 to 8 meters).
- Size of entities increased.

Thanks to all the Hunters and Hunteress, we hope this update will make your Ghost Hunters heart run wild !

Regards,
Ghost Hunters Corp team.

notes.title: Development advancement 2
notes.content:
Hello to all,

This update is giving the developer a hard time, but rest assured, it's on the way. It will be released next week, with its share of excitement.

I will bring up a few more points regarding the bugs, improvements, and changes that this update will bring.

First of all, a lot of bugs causing the game to crash have been fixed, this will allow a much less obstructed gaming experience.
Additionally, the developer is working to fix Writing Book and Camera related bugs.
The new Ghost AI has also been corrected to allow better immersion, and more scares.

A modification of the difficulty will also be part of the update. You will have access to "Simple Investigations" from the start of the game, then to "Paranormal Investigations" at level 5. These game modes will be recommended to players who want to enjoy a game that is more focused on the investigation and research of entities.
Then you will have access to "Simple Extreme Investigations" at level 10, and finally to "Paranormal Extreme Investigations" at level 15. These two game modes are more difficulty-oriented, for people who want to face a more aggressive ghost who wants nothing more than to take your life.

With further game modifications, we changed the look and the information available on the end-of-mission board, in order to know the different clues present, what you have achieved, or what you have missed, etc.
In addition, bonuses in XP and Money rewards will be given for missions carried out within the larger maps.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40514161/55ca39f883b582ad7418596c6dfd838e261c3afb.jpg[/img]

The entity's AI will undergo a large improvement. To promote the exploration of maps and the search for the entity, the entity will start in a "rest" mode (you will be able to explore and look around). This mode stops once a player approaches the entity (by entering its haunting room for example). In addition, the AI ​​will stop targeting a specific player once it becomes aggressive, it can now change target depending on the distance between the players, if the player is accessible, or if the player is not in an area protected by a Crucifix or a Statue of Mary.

I would like once again to thank the community which actively participates for the different translations, with a special thanks to Roo who did a great job with the English translation.

Hope this preview for the next update gets you as excited as we are!

Ah yes, I forgot a little information I think ...
The third map will be… the Japanese Temple.

Thank you for your attention,
Cordially,
The Ghost Hunters Corp team.

notes.title: Hotfix & Adjustment (regarding the Patchnote of 07.30.2021)
notes.content:
Feedback from the community is very important to us, they allow us to question certain choices, to support us in our decisions.

Following many feedback regarding the "stack overflow" error, we advise you to use the "Windows 10 Dictation" mode instead of the "Low" & "High" Detection modes. Don't forget to activate the option on your computer in Settings -> Privacy -> Speech, Inking & Typing (Privacy Policy).

Debug

Contract difficulty has been readjusted after the release of the update on 07/30/2021.
Correction of a bug concerning the thermometer which remains stuck on the value "-".

Gameplay

Our desire with Ghost Hunters Corp is to create a unique supernatural experience, with intelligent entities, which can adapt to the behaviors of the players, for that, we announced two new interactions for the entity, with an overhaul of the AI. For new interactions, they are divided into three "possibilities", including one that has just been deactivated for maintenance:
The entity is smarter, understands that there is a defensive or noxious object on the ground, and will bypass it (if it can) in an attempt to reach its target.
The entity can now pass through windows, cracks, gaps to get outside or inside if that allows it to bypass a difficulty and hit its target.
If the entity senses more than three defensive objects on the ground around it, it will propel them so that it can pass. /! \ ATTENTION /! \ Following feedback from the community about potential glitches from objects powered by the entity, this last interaction has been deactivated in order to make a readjustment.

notes.content:

The biggest new of this patch is a major overhaul of AI (supernatural entities). Feedback from the community has helped us a lot, the entity has been revised and will act in a more unpredictable way. Additionally, there are plenty of improvements to come and the AI ​​needed a good cleanup.
- AI recoding for better multiplayer synchronization and better fluidity in actions.

In order to perfect and improve the performance of Ghost Hunters Corp, we have fixed many bugs, including:

- Spirit Box EVPs are now heard correctly by all players in Multiplayer.
- The Audio driver used (Low or High) is no longer defined by the system but by the loaded language file in order to avoid language change bugs.

We are very grateful to our benevolent community thanks to which we can offer you numerous language supports (oral and written). Thanks to you, we can improve Ghost Hunters Corp. Here are the languages ​​affected by the corrections:
- English.
- Spanish.
- Russian.
- Chinese.

Other corrections that did not fit into any list were made. Here is a non-exhaustive list :
- If a player leaves the camper van while the map is being launched, the mission will not launch.
- Change of save method to avoid the disappearance of the content of some save.
- Embedded vocal. Replacement of Unity "MessageEvent" by the RegisterCallback class which is more secure on output function calls.
- Change of the algorithm for updating entities on the network for better responsiveness / updating.

[list]
[*] Gameplay
[/list]
One of the biggest advances of this patch is the arrival of two new interactions for the entity, which will only be described here a few days after the patch's release, to give you time to discover them for yourself ... but think about looking well everywhere when looking for the entity, and expect to have to run.

- Added the ability to change the audio driver directly in the tablet options.
- The exorcism book closes when dropped.

- The free and paid contracts have been reversed on the contract purchasing table for better readability. In addition, the design of the contracts to be chosen has been slightly revised.
- In the camper van, the text explaining that no contract has been chosen is now red for better visibility.
